ruleset.name: search-ranking-optimizer-parameter-list
ruleset.description: Parameter-count check, exempting Facades, Facade interfaces, and Mappers: a module Facade's public API grows one parameter per orthogonal, independently-optional run configuration a feature adds over time (queueOptimizationRun's own docblock documents each one individually), and a Mapper's constructor takes one parameter per input a mapping genuinely depends on (ParameterVectorMapper takes one float per tunable dimension it maps into the search vector, plus that dimension's optional pinned value). Collapsing either into a single options array/DTO would trade a self-documenting, individually-typed parameter list for an equally large but less discoverable one, not actually reduce complexity. Run as its own phpmd invocation, separate from phpmd.xml — see that file's description for why.
